title: h-guard configuration
description: h-guard configuration file (config schema 1). Layers are merged in order: built-in defaults, the user config, then --config. Every field except version falls back to the layer below. This schema checks the shape; value checks that need context (references between backends and profiles, regular expressions) are done by "h-guard config validate", which is authoritative.

version.description: Configuration format version. Every config file must declare it.

locale.description: Language of the messages shown to you and the agent: en or zh-CN (forms such as zh_CN.UTF-8 are accepted). Unset or unsupported: taken from LC_ALL or LANG, falling back to en.

judge.description: The judge (a model) that decides the dangerous-operation rules.

enabled.description: Ask the judge. Off by default; "h-guard init" picks a backend, asks for consent and turns it on.

backend.description: Name of the backend to use (a key under backends). Built-in: claude-haiku, claude-sonnet, gemma4-local, jev.

action.description: Checks on the agent's actions (commands and file operations).

tier.description: 1 = commands; 2 = also file reads, writes, deletes and renames; 3 = also other tool calls and HTTP requests (no rules cover these yet).

outbound.description: Checks on prompts and tool output (credentials, private keys, personal data).

tier.description: 1 = prompts; 2 = also file contents in tool output; 3 = all tool output.

judge_max_chunks.description: Maximum number of chunks a long text is split into for the judge.

judge_min_chars.description: Texts shorter than this many characters are not sent to the judge.

judge_chunk_chars.description: Maximum number of characters in one chunk sent to the judge.

categories.description: Policy per outbound category (the detection rules live in rule packs). Built-in categories: credentials, private_key, pii. Fields not written keep the value from the layer below.

judge.description: Use the judge for outbound checks. When false, prompts and tool output are never sent to the backend, and consent does not cover them.

rules.description: Turn single rules on or off by rule id ("h-guard config show" lists them).

backends.description: Judge backends by name. Built-in: jev, claude-haiku, claude-sonnet, gemma4-local. A backend with the same name as a built-in one replaces it.

profiles.description: Calibration profiles by name, referenced from backends.<name>.profile.

policy.description: Behavior on failures and limits on input size.

on_unavailable.description: What to do when the judge is needed but unavailable.

when_ask_unsupported.description: What to do when the harness cannot ask the user for confirmation.

request_window.description: Number of the user's most recent prompts sent to the judge to decide whether the user asked for the operation.

max_command_chars.description: Commands longer than this many characters are shortened in the middle before being sent to the judge.

max_request_chars.description: User prompts longer than this many characters are shortened in the middle before being sent to the judge.

harnesses.description: Settings per harness (claudecode, codex, opencode, pi, omp, dsh, openclaw, ...).

shell.description: Shell assumed when the harness cannot tell which shell runs a command (default: posix).

read_only_tools.description: Tools the harness's adapter does not know that only read and need no confirmation; * and ? match any characters. Tools the adapter knows are always checked.

log.description: Decision log. The health log is always on.

decisions.description: Write a decision log with the full commands (credentials h-guard recognizes are masked).

category.description: Policy of one outbound category. A category that is not configured is enabled with action deny.

action.description: What a hit does: deny blocks, warn only reports (harnesses cannot ask for confirmation on prompts and tool output).

ignore.description: Values that are not counted as hits (compared after trimming spaces; email addresses case-insensitively).

question.description: Question sent to the judge (in English): does the text contain this category?

backend.description: A judge backend. Only type and profile are common to all backends; other fields depend on the backend type, see docs/guide/configuration.md. Each backend type rejects fields it does not know.

profile.description: Calibration profile (a key under profiles). Without a matching profile, conservative thresholds are used.
Calibration profile of a backend. It is used only when its fingerprint matches the backend's model, probability method and question set.

thresholds.description: Thresholds. hit, veto and requested must be written together; a profile calibrated only for outbound may write outbound alone.

hit.description: Probability at or above which a rule question counts as a hit.

veto.description: Probability at or below which the judge's no withdraws a local hit.

requested.description: Probability at or above which the user is taken to have asked for the operation.

radius_floor.description: Lower bound of the blast radius per rule id, overriding the rule pack.

outbound.description: Probability at or above which an outbound category question counts as a hit.

fingerprint.description: What the profile was calibrated with (written by "h-guard eval --sweep").

model.description: Model the profile was calibrated with.

questions.description: Digest of the action question set: sha256:<64 hex digits>.

outbound_questions.description: Digest of the outbound question set: sha256:<64 hex digits>.
